mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2% over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past 6 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past 3 months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2% over the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points signals a loosening of monetary policy, which increases liquidity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 25bps over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months, it signals a strong consumer-driven economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth > 5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both conditions are met over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 over the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it signals a supply-side constraint combined with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when both conditions are met over the next 20 trading days.
